note: Enhanced Entity Browser has no settings form and no configure route. Its entire persistent state is one plain config object per entity browser, entity_browser_enhanced.widgets.<entity_browser_id>, whose keys are the UUIDs of that browser's widgets and whose values are enhancer plugin ids ('multiselect', 'autoselect') or '_none_'. The dropdown is only added to widgets whose plugin is 'view'. Enhancers themselves are a YAML-discovery plugin type, entity_browser_enhanced_plugin (manager service plugin.manager.entity_browser_enhanced_plugin), discovered from <module>.enhancers.yml with four required keys: id, label, form_extra_class, library. Medium cases read live enhancer assignments back off real entity browsers; hard cases require writing an assignment and defining a new enhancer plugin, both verified against live state.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with the entity_browser_enhanced module, how do I turn on the Enhanced Multiselect behaviour for an entity browser, and where exactly is that choice stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: Edit the entity browser (/admin/config/content/entity_browser), go to the Widgets step, and pick 'Enhanced Multiselect' in the 'Select enhancer' dropdown that appears on each View widget row. The choice is stored in the config object entity_browser_enhanced.widgets.<entity_browser_id>, keyed by the widget's UUID, with the enhancer id ('multiselect', 'autoselect') or '_none_' as the value.

evals.prompt: I enabled entity_browser_enhanced but the 'Select enhancer' dropdown only shows up on some of my entity browser's widgets. Which widget type does it apply to, and which enhancers ship with the module?
evals.expected_output: Only widgets whose plugin is the Entity Browser 'view' widget (instances of Drupal\entity_browser\Plugin\EntityBrowser\Widget\View) get the dropdown; upload/entity_form and other widget types are skipped. The module ships two enhancers: multiselect ('Enhanced Multiselect') and autoselect ('Enhanced Autoselect').

evals.prompt: How do I define my own enhancer plugin for the Drupal entity_browser_enhanced module? Which file does the definition go in and which keys are required?
evals.expected_output: Enhancers are a YAML-discovery plugin type (entity_browser_enhanced_plugin, manager plugin.manager.entity_browser_enhanced_plugin). Add a <mymodule>.enhancers.yml file with a definition carrying four required keys: id, label, form_extra_class (extra CSS class placed on the browser form) and library (a module or theme asset library). The plugin manager throws a PluginException if any of them is empty. Then assign the enhancer id to a View widget's UUID in entity_browser_enhanced.widgets.<browser_id>.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an entity browser with the machine name 'ebe_demo'. An entity_browser_enhanced enhancer has been assigned to its widget. Inspect the running site and tell me which enhancer is assigned.
evals.expected_output: The 'multiselect' (Enhanced Multiselect) enhancer. The config object entity_browser_enhanced.widgets.ebe_demo maps the View widget's UUID (aaaaaaaa-1111-4111-8111-ebe000000001, from entity_browser.browser.ebe_demo widgets) to 'multiselect'.

evals.prompt: The entity browser 'ebe_two' on this Drupal site has two View widgets, labelled 'Photos' and 'Documents'. Only one of them has an entity_browser_enhanced enhancer assigned. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which widget it is and which enhancer it uses.
evals.expected_output: The 'Documents' widget uses the 'autoselect' enhancer. In entity_browser_enhanced.widgets.ebe_two the Documents widget UUID (aaaaaaaa-1111-4111-8111-ebe000000003) maps to 'autoselect' while the Photos widget UUID (…0002) is set to '_none_'.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an entity browser with the machine name 'ebe_task' that contains a single View widget. Using the entity_browser_enhanced module, assign the Enhanced Multiselect enhancer to that widget and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The config object entity_browser_enhanced.widgets.ebe_task must map the View widget's UUID (read it from entity_browser.browser.ebe_task widgets) to the string 'multiselect' - via the 'Select enhancer' dropdown on the browser's Widgets step, or by writing the config directly.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, extend the entity_browser_enhanced module with a new enhancer plugin of your own. It must be discoverable on the live site with the plugin id 'ebe_zoom', carry a human-readable label, an extra form CSS class, and point at an asset library that actually exists and resolves on this site (provide that library yourself). Build it as a custom module under web/modules/custom and enable it.
evals.expected_output: A custom module (e.g. web/modules/custom/ebe_zoom_enhancer) with an <module>.enhancers.yml declaring ebe_zoom with id/label/form_extra_class/library, plus a <module>.libraries.yml defining the referenced library and its JS/CSS file, installed and cache-rebuilt so plugin.manager.entity_browser_enhanced_plugin->getDefinitions() contains 'ebe_zoom' and library.discovery resolves its library.
